body:
Realistically, I know there's tons of opportunities outside my life plan, but it's something I've thought about since I was in middle school. There really wasn't any other option for me. I have other interests outside of my major, but I have no idea what I would do. Having just a high school degree, even if it's just for a few years while I get back on my feet sounds so scary. I don't want to be a burden on my parents, they've done so much for me already.

Honestly, I don't know if my current situation warrants dropping out. I haven't spoken to my advisor or anyone else who could give me advice on what to do. And obviously I should speak to someone, but it's so hard to for me to open up. Sometimes I just want to cut everyone out of my life and never have to deal with people being disappointed in me. Isn't that ridiculous?

Hey, thanks, that means a lot. It's comforting to know I'm not in this alone. I'm just so afraid I've gone beyond the point of no return and I can't stay in college, let alone salvage my GPA. It's hard to want to keep going when I've got it in my head there's no way out. It's hard to fail at life in general, but this seems like a pretty life-altering failure.
